name: devrelay-desktop
description: Deterministic DevRelay orchestration, human operator control, worktrees, and persistent ProjectMemory for ChatGPT Desktop on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate and inspect safe agent work with durable memory.
interface.longDescription: Runs approved DevRelay dependency frontiers through isolated ChatGPT Desktop tasks and Git worktrees, projects one deterministic human operator view of agents, queues, blockers, quality, approvals, worktrees, and memory, routes typed interventions to bounded authorities, and preserves restart-safe ProjectMemory context.
defaultPrompt: Run the next approved DevRelay frontier.
Show the current DevRelay human operator view and work queue.
Request a typed intervention for a DevRelay task or work item.
Recover this DevRelay run after interruption.
